turns.text: Hello there, how are you doing today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A few friends invited me on a long weekend ride.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fun! They're doing either the flat forty mile loop or the hilly twenty five mile one. Which do you think your legs can handle?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait, my friend just got here. Can you hold on and stay quiet until I'm back?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sofia, which microphone did you buy for your show?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A cheap USB one. It's honestly fine for talking.

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: friend

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's cramped though. You learn to sit very still.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm done, you can have the bathroom.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sofia, what day is the dentist?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Right. You were picking the weekend ride, flat and long or short and hilly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let's do the hilly one, I could use the challenge.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Nice. Shift into an easy gear early before each climb.
